definitions.gloss: visiting a grave; paying respects at a grave
definitions.explanation: The act of visiting a family grave to clean it, offer flowers, incense, and food, and pray for the deceased. An important cultural practice in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{墓参|はかまい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I visit the grave during Obon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{墓参|はかまい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きた。
examples.english: We went as a family to visit grandmother's grave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{彼岸|ひがん}→お彼岸：08933_ohigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧お{墓参|はかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Every year during the spring and autumn equinox weeks, I make it a point to go back home and visit the graves.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
お{墓参|はかまい}り is an important Japanese custom. Families typically visit graves during ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (mid-August), ⟦お{彼岸|ひがん}→お彼岸：08933_ohigan⟧ (equinox weeks in March and September), and ⟦{命日|めいにち}→命日：17539_meinichi⟧ (death anniversaries). The visit involves cleaning the gravestone, offering ⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧ (incense), ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flowers), and sometimes food or drink, and praying.

FORMS:
The plain form ⟦{墓参|はかまい}り→墓参り：10663_hakamairi⟧ (without お) is also used but sounds less polite. ⟦{墓参|ぼさん}→墓参：23486_bosan⟧ is a more formal reading used in written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{墓参|はかまい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go visit a grave)
- お{墓参|はかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to visit a grave)
